title: phaseolus atropurpureus var. canescens
intro: Phaseolus atropurpureus var. canescens, commonly known as the purple wild bean, is a variety of perennial bean plant native to North America. The purple wild bean has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, as well as its potential to manage blood sugar levels and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of the purple wild bean include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hypoglycemic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of the purple wild bean have been shown to have a range of biological activities, including scavenging free radicals and modulating the immune response.
